summary: urban-gro, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Forbearance Agreement and Exchange Agreement with Hudson Global Ventures, LLC after Grow Hill assigned loan documents to Hudson. The borrower was in default on ~$1.94M obligations; Hudson agreed to forbear until April 30, 2026, and the principal was increased to $2.8M including a capitalized forbearance fee. Under the Exchange Agreement, Hudson reduces part of the loan balance in exchange for common stock. Terms such as price per share, premium, and board recommendation are not disclosed. This appears to be a debt restructuring, but the filing lacks definitive special-situations triggers; it is primarily a forbearance and debt-for-equity exchange with no mention of a broader strategic review or liquidation. The filing is routine for a distressed company and does not clearly fall into a special-situation category.
